integrity: The lower bound is a direct finite hyperplane-cover count. The upper bounds are explicit projective-line constructions in two-dimensional subspaces, with matching structure checked separately in odd and even characteristic. Computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite fields and dimensions at least three.
Dimension two is excluded because the isotropy type of the standard form changes the matching geometry.
The finite checker covers selected prime-field instances; arbitrary prime powers are covered by the proof rather than exhaustive computation.
title: Total and paired domination of finite-field total dot product graphs
